extDescription.message: Your own list of redirects: open a URL and land straight on the page you actually need.

hint.message: When you open a URL from the “From” column, the browser goes straight to the “To” URL. Rules higher in the list take precedence. If a site redirects you by itself (e.g. to /welcome), add a rule for that page too.

permissionHint.message: When you save, Chrome will ask for access to the sites in the “From” column — redirects cannot work without it. The extension never reads page content or sends anything anywhere.

emptyState.message: No rules yet. Click “Add rule”, or open a site and click the extension icon.

typesExact.message: Exact URL — same domain and path; a trailing slash and anything after ? are ignored. https://example.com matches https://example.com/?a=1 but not /app.

typesDomain.message: Whole site — any page on this domain.

typesPrefix.message: Starts with — the URL starts with the given one (http and https are treated the same).

typesRegex.message: Regular expression — RE2 syntax; use groups \1, \2… in “To”. Example: ^https://old\.example\.com/(.*) → https://new.example.com/\1. Requires access to all sites.

fixErrors.message: Fix the errors in the highlighted rules

permissionDenied.message: Not saved: redirects cannot work without access to the sites

noAccess.message: No access to this site — click “Save” to grant it

regexUnsupported.message: Chrome does not support this expression: $1

errScheme.message: only http and https are supported

errLoop.message: The target URL matches this same rule — that would be an endless redirect
